components.name: Button primary
components.description: Café pill with Off-white label; hover adds a Terracota inset ring.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:50px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid #522e24;font:800 .875rem/1.3 var(--font-brand,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.01em;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);background:#522e24;color:#f7efe6}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-button-primary:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #c1754a;transform:translateY(-2px)}}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #522e24;outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary:hover{transform:none}}

components.name: Button outline

components.css: .ds-button-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:50px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid #522e24;font:800 .875rem/1.3 var(--font-brand,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.01em;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);background:transparent;color:#522e24}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-button-outline:hover{background:#522e24;color:#f7efe6;transform:translateY(-2px)}}.ds-button-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #522e24;outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-outline:hover{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: Nardini is a founder's surname: every product is a signed choice. The identity is natural without being rustic and premium without being cold: five earthy colors, one robust contemporary sans-serif with light spacing, and the N monogram where the founder's initial meets a dog's silhouette. Pages read like the brand manual's spreads: quiet off-white and areia surfaces, solid café blocks, one terracota accent, and generous room around the mark.
keyCharacteristics: The five official colors only, with Café as the base and Terracota as the accent.
One brand family in two weights: ExtraBold for titles, Regular for everything else.
Graphic blocks and diagonal cuts from the N monogram, used as support, never as excess.
Official logo files, never redrawn, recolored, cropped or distorted.
A dog shown with presence, confidence and bond: affection without infantilization.

rules.name: The 70 / 20 / 10 Rule
rules.body: Café carries most of the brand color weight, Terracota stays an accent, Argila/Areia/Off-white keep the view breathing.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Terracota carries only large text, and only on Off-white or Café; never text on Areia, and never small text or buttons on a Terracota fill.

rules.name: The Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Keep a clear area around every logo at least the height of the word SELECT.

dos: Do check every piece against the manual's approval checklist: right logo version, contrast, official palette, readable type, unaltered dog, breathing room.
Do write in the brand voice: specialist but close; say cão and cães.
Do keep Café as the base and Terracota as the accent, only where the Contrast Rule allows.
Do keep text, links and images independent in code.
Do use real storefront photography to help visitors recognize the shop.
donts: Don't use colors outside the five-color palette, or saturated combinations.
Don't redraw, recolor, crop, distort or regenerate any brand mark.
Don't put the horizontal logo on Café or Terracota, or small text and buttons on Terracota.
Don't combine a giant dog, the seal and text in the same panel.
Don't call the store a pet shop or use infantilizing copy.
Don't turn the pillars or contact options into decorative cards.
Don't display the phone number in the interface or the storefront image.
Don't add a feed, prices, a product catalog or checkout to the institutional home.
